resources.string: Nightjar streams from any Moonlight-compatible streaming app running on your PC. Start it and keep both devices on the same network, and the PC appears in your list. If it doesn’t, select Add PC and enter the PC’s IP address. If it still can’t connect, allow the streaming app through the PC’s firewall.
Select the PC and keep the PIN on screen. Enter that PIN in the PC’s settings or web UI. If the PC has per-device permissions, allow this device to list and launch apps.
